name: Athletics - Basketball Season
service: The path one fan travels across a single men's and women's basketball season, from first contact through renewal, lapse, or a first gift to the Triton Athletic Fund. Spans marketing, ticketing, game-day operations, the Triton Athletic Fund, and central Advancement. Mapped against the season just completed; the 2026–27 season is UC San Diego's first in the West Coast Conference.
